summary: E2E tested redesigned classic consumer shell (Phase A dual theme + Phase B nav/chips/avatar + Phase C card grammar + shell backend). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass for /api/shell/summary + /api/shell/prefs. Web: shell-desktop loads on demo login with correct sidebar sections (Primary/Discover/Rewards/Your stations - 8 flagships), Podcasts hidden (count=0), badges shown for Shop & Eat + Games, filter chips render with LIVE counts (Radio 14, Eat 5, Salons 2, Fitness 1, Shops 3, Games 3, Offers 11, World 5,021), chip filtering re-scopes home feed correctly (chip-offers → only venues, chip-radio → only shows+stations), theme toggle flips html[data-theme] dark↔light and persists after reload via PUT /api/shell/prefs, search-input placeholder includes '5,035+', topbar-cart + PointsPill + NotificationBell present, home-root feed shows greeting with user's name (Demo), stations/clips/your-stations/venues/news/games-strip in correct order. Avatar menu: demo (listener) sees only Settings+Logout (no Tools); admin sees Tools with menu-admin/menu-creator/menu-advertiser. /admin route: data-admin-route='true', shell-sidebar & filter-chips hidden. Mobile 390x844: shell-mobile with 5 bottom tabs (tab-home/tab-radio/tab-shop-eat/tab-games/tab-wallet), mobile-hamburger opens mobile-drawer with badges, filter chips visible.

issues: Cookie banner (bottom-right) overlaps top of the persistent player and floats above content; may block avatar-menu interactions until dismissed. Only observed on first visit.

spec_vs_impl_mismatches.impact: cosmetic — visual + behavior are correct; only the testID string differs from the PRD list. Either update spec or rename in AppShell.jsx PRIMARY_NAV keys ('shop'→'shop-eat', 'predict'→'predict-win') if downstream automation depends on the PRD names.

spec_vs_impl_mismatches.spec: not in this PRD; role-gated Tools = Admin/Creator/Advertiser/Ad Review
spec_vs_impl_mismatches.actual: menu-ad-review is HIDDEN for admin users because code renders it only when canAdReview && !canAdmin (AppShell.jsx:330). Admins never see it.

OPTIONAL: Confirm whether menu-ad-review should also appear for full admins (currently hidden because of !canAdmin guard in AppShell.jsx:330).
critical_code_review_comments: AppShell.jsx is 546 lines — approaches the 700-line threshold; consider splitting DesktopShell / MobileShell / Sidebar / TopBar / FilterChips / AvatarMenu into their own files.

Two React console warnings observed: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' (likely from a NavItem/MenuRow spread). Non-blocking but easy fix — pull `key` out of the spread and pass it explicitly.
Chip 'trivia' has no count field but other category chips do — consistent with spec (Trivia is a route, not a count), but consider hiding the numeric absence with a fallback style for visual parity.
Backend routes/shell.py uses estimated_document_count() for world stations — acceptable for a summary endpoint but note that this is not always exact; the 5,021+14 total (5,035) matched the PRD.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The classic redesigned shell is verified end-to-end for BOTH desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_shell_endpoints.py runs against the live preview and covers summary + prefs. If retesting after further changes, dismiss the cookie banner first before interacting with avatar menu (it overlays bottom-right and can intercept clicks). Persistent Player at the bottom has NOT been slimmed yet — deferred per PRD. Deep legacy pages (Radio/Wallet/etc.) light-theme audit is out of scope this iteration.
